# Modular Dungeon Kit attribution

"Modular Dungeon Kit" (version 2.1) by [Kenney](https://kenney.nl), downloaded from
[kenney.nl](https://kenney.nl/assets/modular-dungeon-kit) in FBX format.

Licensed under [Creative Commons Zero (CC0)](http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
Attribution is not required; provided here as a courtesy and provenance record.

Only the pieces used by the dungeon game mode are imported (floor, wall, wall corner,
and gate variants plus the shared `colormap.png` texture). The pieces are scaled and
combined into room prefabs in BROcoli's procedurally generated dungeon mode.

`Models/Dungeon/DungeonWallShell.asset` is a BROcoli-authored derivative of the wall:
the loose floor rocks are omitted and the bottom apron is flattened to the structural
slab depth so vertically stacked outer-cliff courses meet without a projecting ledge.
